aspect.taller: about {r} times as tall as it is wide
aspect.wider: about {r} times as wide as it is tall
aspect.square: about as tall as it is wide

light.even: The light is fairly even, so shadows are soft and spread out.
light.dir: The light seems to come from {dir}, so the shadows fall on the opposite side.

page.title: Prepare the page
page.instruction: Place your paper in {orient} orientation. Leave a border of about {marginCm} cm. Your drawing will fill an area about {drawWcm} cm wide and {drawHcm} cm tall. Lightly mark the top, bottom, left and right edges of that area with tiny dots.
page.tip: Press very lightly. These marks are only guides and will be erased later.

shapes.title: Block in basic shapes
shapes.instruction: Look for simple shapes inside the picture. Start with {shapeList}. Draw each one as a loose, light outline. Don't worry about details yet.
shapes.tip: Hold the pencil further from the tip and draw from your shoulder for smoother ovals.

proportions.title: Check proportions
proportions.instruction: The whole subject is {aspectPhrase}. Compare your shapes: {compareList}. Fix any shape that looks too big, too small or out of place before moving on.
proportions.tip: Hold your pencil at arm's length and use it like a ruler to compare sizes.

contours.title: Draw the main outline
contours.instruction: Now follow the outside edge of the subject (its silhouette). Begin at {startPos} and travel around the shape. The outline has {cornerCount} noticeable turns. Use your basic shapes as a frame.
contours.tip: Use several short strokes instead of one long line; it's easier to stay on track.

forms.title: Add the big inner shapes
forms.instruction: Inside the outline there are {internalCount} large areas with clear edges. The biggest one sits near {internalPos}. Draw their boundaries lightly.
forms.tip: Squint at the reference: squinting hides small details and shows the big shapes.

features.title: Refine features
features.instruction: Add the smaller edges and features. Most of the detail is near {detailPos}. Work from the largest features to the smallest, checking each one against the guide.
features.tip: Turn the paper as you draw so your hand moves in a comfortable direction.

clean.title: Clean up the sketch
clean.instruction: Gently erase the construction shapes and the page marks you no longer need. Then go over the lines you want to keep with a slightly firmer stroke.
clean.tip: A kneaded eraser lifts graphite without damaging the paper.

values.title: Shadows and values
values.instruction: {lightSentence} The darkest areas are near {darkPos}. Shade the dark shapes first, then the middle tones. Leave the brightest areas as clean paper.
values.tip: Build darkness slowly with light layers instead of pressing hard.

details.title: Final details
details.instruction: Add texture, small accents and sharp dark touches where the reference shows them, mostly around {detailPos}. Stop when it looks finished to you; not every detail needs to be drawn.
details.tip: Step back from your drawing every few minutes to see it as a whole.

fallback.lowContrast: The picture has low contrast, so the main subject could not be separated from the background automatically. The steps use the whole picture as the subject; try increasing contrast or cropping closer.

compare.wider: Your drawing looks about {pct}% wider than the guide. Try bringing the left and right edges in a little.
compare.narrower: Your drawing looks about {pct}% narrower than the guide. Try widening it slightly.
compare.taller: Your drawing looks about {pct}% taller than the guide.
compare.shorter: Your drawing looks about {pct}% shorter than the guide.
compare.shiftLeft: Your drawing sits a bit to the left of where the guide places it.
compare.shiftRight: Your drawing sits a bit to the right of where the guide places it.
compare.shiftUp: Your drawing sits a bit higher on the page than the guide.
compare.shiftDown: Your drawing sits a bit lower on the page than the guide.
compare.sparse: Around {pos} the guide has lines that your drawing doesn't show yet.
compare.good: Nice work! The overall size and placement closely match the guide.
compare.empty: We couldn't find pencil lines in the photo. Try a brighter, sharper photo taken straight above the paper.
